item.title: Grand Canyon flash flood kills 2, leaves 1 missing
item.description: Two people died and one remains missing after flash flooding at the Grand Canyon over the weekend, with rescuers preparing for more severe weather.

item.title: Tankers attacked as Trump weighs new Iran strikes in 'little war'
item.description: Two oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz as President Trump threatened further strikes on Iran, calling the conflict 'relatively little.'

item.title: Whistleblower: Postal Service mail ballot portal 'rushed' and 'untested'
item.description: A federal official whistleblower revealed concerns about the Postal Service's new mail-voting procedures, calling the portal rushed and untested.

item.title: Tropical Storm Edouard may strengthen to hurricane before landfall
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard is expected to intensify significantly before reaching the northwestern Gulf Coast on Tuesday, possibly becoming a hurricane.
